'''Doug Faust''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 40 from Ithaca, NY. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 he also played [[Young Jedi]], finishing 27th in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck) and 12th in YJ Qualifier 4 (Constructed).<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj04_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier 4 (Constructed)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108191000/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
